overall_goal: Clean the hand blender parts, retrieve ingredients and tools, and set up the weighing scales.

goals.description: Gather the hand blender parts to be washed
goals.rationale: The person moves the hand blender attachment, cup, and cord to the sink area to prepare for washing them.

goals.description: Prepare the sink with hot soapy water
goals.rationale: The person turns on the hot water and adds washing up liquid to the sink to create soapy water for cleaning.

goals.description: Wash the hand blender cup and lid
goals.rationale: The person uses a sponge and soapy water to thoroughly clean the inside and outside of the hand blender cup and its lid.
The person submerges and scrubs the hand blender attachment in the hot soapy water to clean it.

goals.description: Rinse the hand blender parts with cold water
goals.rationale: The person rinses the soap off the hand blender cup, lid, and attachment under cold running water.

goals.description: Dry the hand blender parts with a tea towel
goals.rationale: The person uses a tea towel to dry the freshly washed hand blender attachment and cup before placing them on the countertop.

goals.description: Retrieve the grater and lemons for the recipe
goals.rationale: The person searches the cupboards to find a grater and retrieves a bag of lemons from the fridge.

goals.description: Put the lemons back in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge and places the bag of lemons back into the fruit and vegetable drawer.

goals.description: Unbox, set up, and tare the weighing scales
goals.rationale: The person takes the weighing scales out of their box, turns them on, and tares them with a saucer on top.

goals.description: Manage the raspberries and store the punnet
goals.rationale: The person handles a punnet of raspberries, removes excess fruit, and puts the punnet back into the fridge.
